prompts.idle:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: four keyframes for a transparent animated GIF of the FREYJA web application's Agent mascot, idle state.
Input image 1 is ONLY an identity and style reference: the application's background illustration. Create an ORIGINAL Q-version of that silver-haired purple-flower fantasy girl, faithful to her recognisable palette and costume details. Do not reproduce the background.
Subject: one very cute two-heads-tall chibi female fantasy assistant, big round violet eyes, long ivory-white hair with a tiny curled forelock, two dark-purple flower hairclips with small gold star centres, deep-purple cape sleeves with fine gold trim, modest white ruffled short dress and little purple ankle boots. Family-friendly fully dressed, charming gentle face, rounded soft linework, polished anime game mascot. Readable at tiny UI sizes, simplify ornamental detail.
Output ONE animation sprite sheet with EXACTLY FOUR complete figures, arranged in a perfectly regular 2-column by 2-row grid, reading order top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right. Square canvas, every quadrant same size, no frame borders, no labels, no text, no watermark. Genuine transparent background including all empty space. Each figure identical identity, proportions, camera angle and drawing style. Full body front-facing slightly three-quarter, ample transparent margin on every side, centered horizontally in each quadrant, feet on exactly the same baseline (88 percent of quadrant height). Body height about 76 percent of quadrant height. No ground shadow or background.
Animation IDLE, gentle breathing and blinking:
1. Friendly relaxed smile, violet eyes open, hands resting together in front, cape and hair settled.
2. Same pose, slight inhale lifting shoulders 1 percent, hair tips subtly swing right.
3. Same pose, eyes softly closed for a blink, hair tips centered.
4. Same pose, eyes reopen, subtle exhale, hair tips swing left, ends returning naturally to first pose.
All four are KEYFRAMES of ONE SAME character, not four different characters. Keep feet aligned, costume stable and character large. No floating icons or detached elements. Crisp clean colored outline, delicate cel shading, pastel lavender and ivory with gold. Intended final frame size is 192x208 pixels; source sheet should have generous resolution.
prompts.thinking:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: four animation keyframes for the THINKING state GIF of FREYJA's chibi Agent.
Input image is the approved IDLE sprite sheet and is the exact character identity, costume, scale and rendering style reference. Preserve that same cute silver-haired two-heads-tall girl, very large violet eyes, dark purple flower clips with gold star centres, curled forelock, long fluffy ivory hair, deep purple gold-trimmed cape sleeves, white ruffled modest dress and purple boots. All facial features, clothes and linework must match. Clean polished soft anime cel shading.
Make ONE genuinely transparent sprite sheet with EXACTLY FOUR full-body poses in an evenly spaced 2-column x 2-row grid, row-major order. No text, no labels, no borders, no watermark, no painted checkerboard, no scenery, no ground shadow. Use a portrait-ish sheet with about 12:13 aspect to match reference. Each figure stays inside its quadrant with clear separation and transparent margin, identical scale, consistent front three-quarter view, centered horizontally, feet anchored at 90 percent of cell height, body height about 84 percent of cell height.
THINKING loop: she is pondering a creative shot, one finger touching her cheek/chin, the other arm tucked across her waist.
Frame 1 top-left: violet eyes looking gently up-right, thoughtful small closed mouth, head upright, finger against cheek.
Frame 2 top-right: head tilts a little right, eyes look upward, tiny thoughtful smile, hair follows subtly.
Frame 3 bottom-left: holds the thoughtful tilt, briefly closes both eyes, gently taps chin.
Frame 4 bottom-right: eyes open, head almost upright again, thoughtful calm face, relaxed hair moving back.
Four frames are ONE same character at successive moments. Keep feet baseline and torso size stable; do not turn her into a different girl or redesign clothing. Actual limb and face changes, not recoloring. No symbols or detached objects. No background whatsoever.

WORKING: the assistant is busily preparing a script, holding a small OPEN ivory-and-lavender script notebook at chest/waist height in her left hand and a small gold pen in her right hand. Pages are abstract tiny lines without legible text.
Frame 1: eyes focused down at notebook, right hand with pen raised above page, attentive smile.
Frame 2: pen tip reaches page and she makes a short writing stroke, head tipped down slightly, hair sways right.
Frame 3: another writing stroke farther along the page, content expression, briefly blinks.
Frame 4: eyes open, lifts the pen back up near the starting pose, slight satisfied smile, hair swings back.
ONE same girl across all frames; fixed feet and stable torso scale. Hands and pen actually change positions; notebook and outfit stay consistent. No additional characters or floating UI elements. Keep the notebook small enough not to hide her face or outfit.

prompts.attention:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ATTENTION / needs user response GIF, four animation keyframes for FREYJA web Agent.
The input sheet is the approved EXACT chibi identity/style/costume reference: same tiny fantasy girl with large round head, silver-white long hair, curled forelock, big violet eyes, two violet flowers with gold star centres, purple and gold cape, modest white ruffle dress, purple boots. Create ONE transparent sheet with EXACTLY FOUR complete full-body poses in a neat perfectly regular 2x2 grid, reading top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Every pose must be fully INSIDE its quadrant, with at least 6 percent transparent margin on ALL sides, including hair tips and raised hand. Clear transparent gutters separate poses; do NOT let hair touch or cross a grid boundary. Keep figure about 78 percent of cell height and at most 84 percent of cell width. ATTENTION animation: a friendly gentle wave to attract the user's attention.
1. Bright open violet eyes looking at user, tiny expectant smile, one hand lifted beside her cheek with open palm facing user, the other resting at her waist.
2. Raised hand waves outward slightly from the wrist, head tilts a little toward it, eyes friendly.
3. Raised hand waves inward, briefly one eye winks, playful small smile.
4. Both eyes open, hand moves outward again, head returns closer to upright.
Actual hand movement and expressive wink, ONE SAME GIRL through time. Stable feet baseline and torso size. Preserve costume and hair, keep the raised arm beside the face so it does not extend beyond the cell.
